reader.requirement: At --std 85 an elementary report entry with a COLUMN NUMBER clause presents its SOURCE object, VALUE object or SUM counter on its print line, and an entry with no COLUMN NUMBER clause (a SOURCE or SUM entry, which §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11 Table 1 permits without COLUMN) is not presented.

edition-consulted.switches: at 85 the entry's clause combination is screened against Table 1 (ScreenReportEntryClauseTable: VALUE without COLUMN refused); at 2002+ SR10, SR13 and SR15 are asked instead

reader.edition-search: EmitCompose and EmitFieldPlacements consult no edition: an entry with no COLUMN operand (Columns.Count == 0) emits no placement at any edition. The 2002 column forms are refused by the COBOL0900 construct gate.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf09_05 covers SOURCE with and without COLUMN and a SUM counter without COLUMN; VALUE with figurative constants or ALL, edited and signed SOURCE items, and reference-modified SOURCE operands are not exercised

probes.expected: VALUE ALL "*" at 1, S99 SOURCE without COLUMN absent, -ZZ9 at 5 (-  7, then  12), X(2) SOURCE without COLUMN absent, WS-STR(5:2)=EF at 10, WS-STR(1:1)=A at 13, VALUE SPACES at 15, | at 17; the SUM counter TOT without COLUMN absent and its total 5 shown through SOURCE TOT

probes.printed: error COBOL2247: ... writes PICTURE, VALUE, a combination that no row of Table 1 permits (COLUMN required and missing) (ISO §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11)
error COBOL0900 ... requires COBOL-2002 for COLUMN PLUS, multiple COLUMN and CENTER
probes.expected: §1985:XIII.3.11.2 is COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1 only

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.11.4 GR1  (3.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: EmitCompose places each field of the line through EmitFieldPlacements, which loops over the entry's COLUMN operands, so an entry with none places nothing; a SUM counter without COLUMN still accumulates and is readable through SOURCE. The probe's TOT entry, which carries LINE PLUS 1 itself, produced an empty print line (line 4). That is LINE NUMBER behaviour, outside this rule, and was not judged.
